newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna police say Swissair bomb threat is hoax.
newsitem.headline: Vienna police say Swissair bomb threat is hoax.

text.p: Austrian police gave a Swissair aircraft the all clear to continue its journey to Zurich after a telephoned bomb warning proved to be a hoax, a Vienna airport spokesman said on Sunday.
The plane, on its way to Zurich from Krakow, Poland with 46 passengers on board, was diverted to Vienna after a bomb threat was telephoned to Krakow airport.
"Police have carried out a thorough search of the plane. They have identified all bags and X-rayed luggage. There was no bomb on board," the spokesman said.
The aircraft, a Saab 2000 flown by Swissair's regional airline unit Crossair AG, was likely to continue its journey by 1530 GMT, he added.
The flight had earlier left Poland on schedule at 1210 GMT and had been due to arrive in Zurich airport at 1410 GMT.
